questions_visited.why_selected: Mapped lesson evidence that asks directly for the velocity definition.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: State a precise one-mark definition using displacement and time.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Recall the controlled wording rather than replace displacement with distance.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Writing rate of change of distance describes speed, not velocity.

questions_visited.why_selected: Mapped lesson evidence that asks for displacement directly.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Identify the reference point and include direction.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Giving total path length or omitting direction.

questions_visited.assessed_demand: Add all path lengths and all times, then divide.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Choose total distance, not resultant displacement, before applying the average-speed formula.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Averaging stage speeds or using only one part of the time.

questions_visited.why_selected: Mapped multi-step average-velocity route with perpendicular movement.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Find a resultant magnitude and direction, then divide by total time.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Use a right-angled displacement triangle before calculating vector velocity.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Using the route length as displacement or reporting no direction.

questions_visited.why_selected: Mapped drawing task that distinguishes distance from displacement on a curved path.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Represent path length and the straight start-to-finish vector differently.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Trace the route for distance and join endpoints for displacement.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Drawing the curved route for both quantities.

questions_visited.why_selected: Second mapped representation demand from the same curved-path question.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: Show the displacement as a directed straight line.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Use only initial and final positions, then add direction information.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Treating displacement as total distance without a direction.

questions_visited.why_selected: Mapped lesson evidence requiring a current precise definition of displacement.
questions_visited.assessed_demand: State displacement from a point with direction and straight-line meaning.
questions_visited.reasoning_route: Recall the formal definition, then distinguish it from the route taken.
questions_visited.misconception_or_distractor: Writing only distance from the point, with no direction.
